artworks.title: View of the High Falls of Trenton: West Canada Creek, N.Y.
artworks.medium: color aquatint with hand-coloring on wove paper, mounted to canvas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 47 x 61 cm (18 1/2 x 24 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall surrounded by trees on both sides. The painting includes detailed brushstrokes depicting foliage and rock formations. The color palette consists of blues, greens, and earth tones. In the foreground, two men and a dog observe the waterfall. Other figures are visible in the distance. The waterfall cascades down in tiers. The sky above shows partly cloudy weather with shades of blue and grey.

artworks.title: View of the New York Quarantine, Staten Island
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving onwove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.5 x 61.5 cm (19 1/2 x 24 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene overlooking the waters towards Staten Island. The horizon is low, with buildings and greenery visible along the shoreline in the distance. Several ships with sails are present, some with colorful flags. Closer to the viewer, small boats navigate the water, with figures engaged in various activities. The painting features a detailed yet smooth style, with soft brushstrokes creating a sense of motion in the waves and sky. The color palette includes muted tones of blues and greens in the water, and a gentle gradient of creams and grays with hints of pale blue in the sky.

artworks.title: West Point, from above Washington Valley: Looking down the River
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after George Cooke
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view over a body of water with sailboats reflecting on the surface. The horizon is in the middle with hills, a shoreline, and buildings in the distance. The sky shows soft clouds on a partly cloudy day. The brushwork is detailed, creating a realistic scene with an earth tone color palette. People are seen on a hillside near the water, enjoying the view.

artworks.title: West Point, from Phillipstown
artworks.medium: color aquatint with touches of engraving, hand-colored, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic view of West Point from a vantage point in Phillipstown. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with rounded mountains. A river divides the image horizontally, with sailboats and a steamboat. Lush vegetation fills the base of the image, with detailed brushstrokes. Trees and shrubbery frame the view, with golden and green leaves. The color palette includes greens, browns, blues, and whites. Fluffy clouds are present in the blue sky.

artworks.title: Title Plate
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of an architectural scene with a plaque at the center. The horizon is not visible, and various architectural elements and figures lead towards it. The brushwork is intricate with fine lines and detailed etching giving texture to the structures and sky. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray emphasizing the etching's shadows. Closest to us are steps leading to a large stone plaque with text, surrounded by stone ruins and foliage. In the distance, architectural elements such as domes and columns are visible, hinting at an ancient or classical setting, with wispy clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: La Torre di Malghera
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside view with architectural elements and natural features. The sky occupies a large portion of the upper area, with a few clouds. A tall tower stands on the right side among other structures with chimneys, overlooking a landscape of rolling hills. The scene is detailed with fine lines like an etching, creating a sense of depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast. In the foreground, figures in boats are visible, set against the calm water reflecting the sky above.

artworks.title: Mestre
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a town square next to a canal. Buildings, trees, people, and activities are depicted in fine, intricate brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black. Figures on horseback or walking, along with boats in the canal, are visible. The sky is overcast with detailed cloud formations.

artworks.title: Al Dolo
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene with buildings lining its banks. A church with a tall spire is visible on the right side. Small boats float on the river, and people are seen on the pathways nearby. The sky occupies the upper half of the image with textured clouds. The artwork is an etching rendered in shades of sepia and gray.

artworks.title: Ale Porte del Dolo
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside scene with small boats on the water. Buildings line the horizon, with one having a tall spire. Figures and boats can be seen along the shore. The etching is detailed with fine line work, capturing textures of walls, roofs, and water. The color palette is monochrome in shades of black and gray. Closest to us, there is a wooden structure and figures attending to boats near the shore.

artworks.title: Le Porte Del Dolo
artworks.description: The image portrays a detailed architectural view from an elevated perspective of a canal lock system. The composition features buildings, a canal, figures engaging in various activities, and trees in the distance. The style is characterized by intricate line work typical of etchings, and the color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white emphasizing details and line work.

artworks.title: Pra della Valle
artworks.description: The image shows a public square with many people and various activities. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, showcasing the wide space filled with small figures. In the distance, there are trees, buildings, and a church with a tower. The right side exhibits detailed architecture with arcades. The image is created through fine etching, emphasizing details and textures in black, white, and gray colors.

artworks.title: S. Giustina in pra della Vale
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated perspective of an open space with a grand building in the distance. The detailed etching features linear brushstrokes emphasizing architecture and figures in a monochromatic palette. Figures are engaged in various activities in the foreground, while the background showcases the impressive building with domes and towers.

artworks.title: View of a Town on a River Bank
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a village, and a bell tower. The composition includes a wooded area in the foreground with a broken tree trunk. Figures on horseback are crossing the river. The color scheme is predominantly black and gray. The sky has clouds and adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Portico with the Lantern
artworks.description: The image shows a grand, arching stone structure framing a scene with detailed carvings on the pillars. In the distance, classical buildings are visible, along with sailing ships suggesting a harbor or river scene. The brushstroke technique is fine lines and crosshatching, typical of an etching, capturing textures of stone and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and white. The image balances shadow and light, adding depth and detail.

artworks.title: Imaginary View of Padua
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a city skyline in the background. In the foreground, there are people and various structures, creating a busy scene. The detailing is intricate, with fine textures and a monochromatic color palette of black and white, giving a timeless quality to the artwork.

artworks.title: The House with the Inscription [left]
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed historical urban scene using fine etching techniques. The perspective is slightly elevated, offering a view of buildings leading towards the horizon. The rooftops and a dome-shaped structure dominate the horizon. Intricate linear strokes and crosshatching create texture and depth. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes detail and forms. Stone structures, buildings, and a figure are depicted in the foreground. Lines show movement and structure in the clouds above.

artworks.title: The House with the Peristyle [right]
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving. It shows a scene from an elevated point of view looking over a body of water with boats and bustling activities. The horizon line is at the center of the composition, aligning with distant hills and the cityscape. Dome-like structures sit on the horizon. Architectural elements and figures are depicted with fine linear hatching, creating textures and shadows. The monochromatic palette contrasts sharply with white areas. An individual is perched on a structure on the right, overlooking the scene. A building in the center has ornate window designs, and figures are rowing small boats. The perspective and technique create depth, drawing the viewer into the scene.

artworks.title: View of a Town with a Bishop's Tomb
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking out over a landscape with architectural structures. On the left side, there is a detailed architectural structure with columns and arches topped by a statue. Beyond this, there are structures scattered across a low horizon with hills extending towards the right side. The artwork uses meticulous etching with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to black for a serene and detailed depiction of the landscape.

artworks.title: La libreria. V. [upper left]
artworks.description: The image features a classical architectural city scene with intricate details. A building occupies the right side of the image extending into the distance while a tall column is visible towards the left. The lower horizon suggests an urban square setting. The image appears as an etching with fine lines and hatching to show texture and shadow. The monochromatic color palette enhances the historical feel. The sky has horizontal and diagonal lines indicating clouds. People in period attire are shown in the plaza, engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: Le Procuratie niove e S. Ziminian V. [upper right]
artworks.description: The image shows a city square with several buildings in the background. A flagpole stands tall in the distance. The detailed etching captures the architecture and people in the square. The color scheme is monochromatic, with browns and blacks dominating. People in period attire are depicted conversing or walking around. The sky is clear with light clouds, framed by grand buildings on either side of the square.

artworks.title: La Piera del Bando. V. [lower right]
artworks.description: The image is an etching displaying a busy scene in Venice, focusing on the area near the Doge's Palace. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a piazza leading to Venetian architecture. The horizon is above the heads of distant figures, with columns and domes defining the skyline. The etching features precise, linear strokes capturing architectural details and a lively crowd. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white shades to create contrast and depth. People in flowing garments gather in the foreground, while ships' masts can be seen in the distance, indicating the proximity of water and the city's lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Le Preson. V. [lower left]
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling urban waterfront scene from a slightly elevated point of view. Buildings line the horizon, with intricate details and fine lines in the etching. The color palette is monochromatic, creating contrast and depth. Figures in period attire can be seen near the water, some tending to boats. The buildings in the distance add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Market on the Molo [upper left]
artworks.description: The image shows a busy port scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon divides the sky and the cluster of buildings and ships along the waterfront. Various architectural structures are visible, with domes and towers in the distance. The intricate line work captures textures of buildings, figures, and ships. The monochromatic color palette contrasts dark lines with a lighter background, giving it an etching-like appearance. People are engaged in activities by the waterfront, with ships and buildings in the cityscape beyond. Horizontal lines and sparse clouds fill the sky.
